description: Create a new ad campaign. Defaults to PAUSED status. Requires name and objective. Budget can be set at campaign or ad set level.

account_id.description: Ad account ID to create the campaign in (e.g. 'act_123' or '123'). Falls back to META_AD_ACCOUNT_ID env var if omitted.

bid_strategy.description: Bid strategy: LOWEST_COST_WITHOUT_CAP, LOWEST_COST_WITH_BID_CAP, COST_CAP, LOWEST_COST_WITH_MIN_ROAS. Meta defaults new campaigns to LOWEST_COST_WITH_BID_CAP, which requires a bid_amount on every ad set — pass LOWEST_COST_WITHOUT_CAP to avoid that.

daily_budget.description: Daily budget in account currency cents (e.g. '5000' = $50.00)

is_adset_budget_sharing_enabled.description: Whether ad sets under this campaign can share budget with each other. Required on some newer ad accounts — omitting it can cause campaign creation to fail with 'Must specify True or False in is_adset_budget_sharing_enabled'.

lifetime_budget.description: Lifetime budget in account currency cents

special_ad_categories.description: JSON array of special ad categories: HOUSING, EMPLOYMENT, FINANCIAL_PRODUCTS_SERVICES, ISSUES_ELECTIONS_POLITICS, NONE. This field is required by Meta on every campaign — pass '[]' or '["NONE"]' if none apply. CREDIT was renamed to FINANCIAL_PRODUCTS_SERVICES; the old name is no longer accepted.

special_ad_category_country.description: JSON array of ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes, e.g. '["US"]'. Required for ISSUES_ELECTIONS_POLITICS (which also requires authorization to run ads in those countries). For HOUSING, EMPLOYMENT, and FINANCIAL_PRODUCTS_SERVICES it is optional and defaults to the ad account's listed tax country if omitted.

spend_cap.description: Lifetime spend cap for the campaign, in account currency cents. Once set it cannot be removed, only raised or reset — pass '0' to reset/clear it.

name: create_campaign
